meta.measure: Share of students scoring Proficient or Advanced (called "Standard Met" or "Exceeded" before 2026)
meta.source: California Department of Education / ETS, CAASPP Smarter Balanced research files (San Francisco County, all student groups; statewide all-students file)
meta.suppression: Groups with fewer than 11 students tested are not reported by the state.
meta.method: Grades 6, 7 and 8 only. K-8 schools and KIPP (grades 5-8) are combined from per-grade student counts, so every school is compared on its middle grades.
